200.description: The server and the database are up

patch.summary: Updates name, time zone or language. Errors: 400 VALIDATION (name required/tooLong, timezone invalid, locale invalid).

delete.summary:
Deletes the account and ends the session; open tasks are redistributed.
Errors: 409 LAST_ADMIN (+groups: names of groups where the user is the only admin).

post.summary: Uploads a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF (field `file`). Errors: 400 VALIDATION (file required/type), 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE.

delete.summary: Removes the uploaded photo; the Google photo or initials show again.

get.summary: The signed-in user. 401 UNAUTHENTICATED means "signed out".

post.summary:
Creates an account, signs it in and sends the verifyEmail email.
Errors: 400 VALIDATION (name required, email invalid, password weak), 409 EMAIL_TAKEN.

Signs in with email and password. The 5th failure in a row locks the account for 15 minutes.
Errors: 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS, 423 ACCOUNT_LOCKED (+retryAfterSeconds).
Ends the session and clears the cookie.
Sends a reset link (valid 1 hour, single use) if the account exists; always answers 204.

Sets a new password from a reset link and signs out every session.
Errors: 400 TOKEN_INVALID, 400 VALIDATION (password weak).
Confirms the email from the link (no session needed). Errors: 400 TOKEN_INVALID.
Sends the verification email again; does nothing once the email is confirmed.

Changes the password and signs out the other sessions.
Errors: 400 WRONG_PASSWORD, 400 VALIDATION (newPassword weak).

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Frontend path to return to after signing in

get.summary: Redirects to Google sign-in, then back to `next`. A separate flow from the calendar connection.

post.summary:
Creates a group with the caller as its admin.
Errors: 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED, 400 VALIDATION (name required/tooLong).

get.summary: The group with its members and their absences. Errors: 403 FORBIDDEN.

delete.summary:
Removes a member (admin); their open tasks are redistributed.
Errors: 403 ADMIN_ONLY, 404 NOT_FOUND (not a member), 409 CANNOT_REMOVE_SELF.

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role (admin).
Errors: 403 ADMIN_ONLY, 404 NOT_FOUND, 409 LAST_ADMIN.

post.summary:
Leaves the group; the caller's open tasks are redistributed. The last member leaving
deletes the group. Errors: 409 LAST_ADMIN when the only admin leaves a group with others.
Creates a 7-day invite link and optionally emails it (admin). Errors: 403 ADMIN_ONLY.

get.summary: What the invite page shows; works signed out. Errors: 410 INVITE_INVALID (unknown, revoked or expired).

post.summary:
Joins the group as a member; idempotent for existing members.
Errors: 410 INVITE_INVALID, 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.

Adds an absence; the caller's automatically assigned open tasks in that period are reassigned.
Errors: 400 VALIDATION (to beforeFrom), 403 FORBIDDEN.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's absences. Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND (missing or someone else's).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound on dueAt, ISO date-time

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive upper bound on dueAt, ISO date-time

parameters.name: seriesId
parameters.description: Only instances of this series (completion history)

get.summary: Instances in `[from, to)` by dueAt, ascending, with computed status. Errors: 403 FORBIDDEN.

post.summary:
Creates a series (admin) and materialises it 4 weeks ahead; returns the first instance.
`assigneeId: null` assigns every instance automatically (FR-27).
Errors: 403 ADMIN_ONLY, 400 VALIDATION (title required/tooLong, dueAt required/inPast,
difficulty range, recurrence noWeekdays).

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `one` changes this instance only, `series` all upcoming unfinished ones

patch.summary:
Edits this instance (`scope=one`) or regenerates the upcoming unfinished instances of the
series (`scope=series`) (admin). Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 403 ADMIN_ONLY, 400 VALIDATION.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: `one` changes this instance only, `series` all upcoming unfinished ones

delete.summary:
Deletes this instance or every unfinished instance of the series (admin); completed ones stay.
Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 403 ADMIN_ONLY.

post.summary: Marks the task done; only its assignee can. Idempotent. Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_ASSIGNEE.

delete.summary:
Undoes the completion: the assignee within 24 hours, an admin at any time.
Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 403 NOT_ASSIGNEE, 409 UNDO_EXPIRED.

patch.summary:
Assigns the task to a member by hand (admin); the algorithm never overrides it (FR-30).
Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 403 ADMIN_ONLY, 409 TASK_DONE, 400 VALIDATION (not a member).

post.summary: Starts the calendar OAuth flow; after consent Google returns to /settings?calendar=connected.

delete.summary: Disconnects the calendar and deletes the stored tokens.

post.summary: Syncs now and resumes a paused sync. Errors: 409 CALENDAR_NOT_CONNECTED.

get.summary: The newest 50 notifications and how many of them are unread.

post.summary: Marks the given notifications, or all of them, as read.

patch.summary: Updates the reminder offset and notification switches.

get.summary: Done, overdue and difficulty per member for the period. Errors: 403 FORBIDDEN.

fields.description: Field code per invalid property, e.g. `{ "title": "tooLong" }` (VALIDATION only)

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until the next attempt is allowed (ACCOUNT_LOCKED)

groups.description: Names of the groups where the user is the last admin (LAST_ADMIN on account deletion)

avatarUrl.description: The uploaded photo, else the Google photo, else null

locale.description: Current UI language; becomes the account language

password.description: At least 8 characters with a letter and a digit (FR-01)

newPassword.description: At least 8 characters with a letter and a digit (FR-01)

GroupRole.description: The caller's role in the group

role.description: The caller's role in the group

color.description: Hex colour of the member in the calendar

role.description: The caller's role in the group

email.description: Also email the link to this address; without it the link is only returned

invitedBy.description: Name of the member who created the invite

alreadyMember.description: True when the signed-in user is already in the group

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday; at least one

manuallyAssigned.description: Set by an admin; the algorithm never overwrites it (FR-30)

dueAt.description: ISO date-time, not in the past

assigneeId.description: A member id, or null for automatic assignment (FR-27)
A member id, or null for automatic assignment (FR-27)

url.description: Google consent page; the frontend navigates to it

SyncStatus.description: `paused` after repeated sync failures; the settings page shows a banner

syncStatus.description: `paused` after repeated sync failures; the settings page shows a banner

groupId.description: Null when the user is no longer in the group (removedFromGroup)

ids.description: Notifications to mark as read; all of them when omitted

assigned.description: Email when a task is assigned to me

overdue.description: Email when my task becomes overdue

reminderMinutes.description: Minutes before the due time when the reminder goes out: 15, 30, 60, 180 or 1440

difficulty.description: Sum of the difficulty of completed tasks
